nina: I'll update Python async snippets. Draft here (will push PR):
```python
# examples/stream_replay_async.py
from redwood.sdk import AsyncStreamingClient

client = AsyncStreamingClient(api_key="${RW_KEY}")

async def replay(resume_token=None):
    stream = await client.start_stream(model="redwood-rlm", resume_token=resume_token, max_inflight=4)
    async for chunk in stream:
        process(chunk.text)
        if should_pause():
            await stream.drain()  # backpressure point
    # final checkpoint token for next run
    return stream.resume_token
```
lee: TS sketch (will include in PR):
```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })

export async function run(resumeToken?: string) {
  const stream = client.stream({ model: 'redwood-rlm', resumeToken, maxInflight: 5 })
  for await (const chunk of stream) {
    console.log(chunk.text)
    if (needThrottle()) await stream.drain()
  }
  return stream.resumeToken
}
```
